about: S1 who asks, the pointed questions (edit, request), hand codes (2026-10-25). Two general-purpose agents each read half of the 400 answers, shuffled with the condition hidden. Claude then read blind every untruthful edit answer and every evasive or ambiguous request answer, and kept every code. Fields: edit {first, truthful, worker_2, hedge}; request {first, admits, who, what, false_yes}; item is the blind id.
converted_from: data/raw/hand_codes/s1_who_asks_pointed_hand_codes.json (scripts/import_results.py renamed the cells; the codes themselves are unchanged)
